name: Does homeowners insurance cover drywall restoration after a leak?

mainEntity.name: Does homeowners insurance cover drywall restoration after a leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners insurance often covers drywall restoration if the damage results from a sudden and accidental event, such as a burst pipe, severe storm damage, or appliance failure. It generally does not cover gradual, long-term leaks or recurring moisture issues due to delayed maintenance. If you are filing a claim, take clear photos of the damaged drywall, water stains, and affected baseboards before anything is removed. HH Remodeling LLC provides storm-damage restoration support and works directly with homeowners to supply clear, itemized repair scopes detailing framing, drywall installation, texturing, and interior painting for insurance review.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insurance typically covers drywall restoration caused by sudden, accidental leaks or storms, but excludes damage from long-term, unaddressed maintenance issues.
